description:
About the Role  
 We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Junior Software Engineer to join our API Engineering team. In this role, you will help design, develop, test, document, and support REST APIs that power business applications, partner integrations, and client-facing services.  

 You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, product managers, quality engineers, and platform teams to learn and apply modern software engineering practices while contributing to secure, scalable, and reliable APIs. This position is ideal for an early-career engineer who is eager to grow in backend development, systems integration, and API design, and who enjoys solving technical problems in a collaborative, mentorship-driven environment.  

 Key Responsibilities  

 API Development  
 Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend services under the guidance of senior engineers.  
 Build and maintain reusable components, libraries, and integration services.  
 Help ensure APIs meet performance, reliability, and security requirements.  
 Learn and apply API versioning and lifecycle management practices.  
 Troubleshoot and help resolve API and integration issues across development and testing environments, escalating complex issues as needed.  
 
 Documentation & Knowledge Sharing  
 Create and maintain clear API and integration documentation, including API specifications, developer guides, and usage examples.  
 Document technical work, implementation notes, and lessons learned.  
 Contribute to team knowledge repositories and engineering best practices.  
 
 Integration & Architecture  
 Support the development of integrations between internal systems, external partners, and cloud services.  
 Follow enterprise architecture standards when implementing API solutions.  
 Learn and contribute to microservices and event-driven integration patterns.  
 Assist with API gateway onboarding and basic policy implementation tasks.  
 
 Quality Engineering  
 Write unit, integration, and automated API tests with guidance from senior team members.  
 Participate in peer code reviews and design reviews to learn team standards.  
 Support CI/CD pipeline usage and basic deployment automation tasks.  
 Help identify reliability, performance, and maintainability issues.  
 
 Security & Compliance  
 Learn and apply secure authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0 and JWT.  
 Follow secure coding practices and enterprise security requirements.  
 Support vulnerability remediation activities as directed.  
 Help ensure appropriate logging and monitoring is implemented in the services you build.  
 
 Collaboration  
 Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and engineering planning activities.  
 Collaborate with product, architecture, security, and operations teams.  
 Communicate progress, questions, and technical ideas clearly to teammates and mentors.  
 Seek feedback and apply it to continuously improve technical skills.  
 
 Required Qualifications  

 Education  
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience, including internships, bootcamps, or personal projects).  
 
 Experience  
 0-2 years of professional software development experience (internships, co-ops, and academic projects are valued).  
 Some exposure to building or consuming REST APIs, through coursework, internships, or personal projects.  
 Familiarity with at least one backend language/framework such as Java, C#, .NET, or Spring Boot.  
 Basic experience with Git-based source control.  
 
 Technical Skills  
 Basic understanding of REST API principles and HTTP protocols.  
 Familiarity with JSON and API integration concepts.  
 Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL.  
 Foundational knowledge of software design patterns and object-oriented programming.  
 Willingness to learn API security concepts, including OAuth 2.0 and JWT.  
 Exposure to automated testing frameworks (unit testing) is a plus.  
 Interest in or coursework experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.  
 Curiosity about containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.  
 Eagerness to learn CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.  
 
 Preferred Qualifications  
 Coursework, certifications, or personal projects involving Microsoft Azure.  
 Exposure to messaging or event-driven concepts (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus).  
 Experience writing basic technical documentation.  
 Familiarity with monitoring/logging concepts.  
 Internship or academic experience in financial services, fintech, or other regulated industries.  
 
 What We Value  
 Strong desire to learn and grow as a software engineer.  
 Analytical and problem-solving mindset.  
 Attention to detail and commitment to writing quality code.  
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.  
 Ability to collaborate effectively and accept mentorship in a team environment.  
 Growth mindset and willingness to adopt new technologies.  
 Ownership mindset with the ability to drive assigned tasks to completion with support.  
 
 Core Technologies  
 REST APIs (foundational)  
 Java, Spring Boot, C#, or .NET  
 Git  
 SQL Databases  
 Basic OAuth 2.0 / JWT concepts  
 
 Nice to Have Technologies  
 Microsoft Azure  
 Docker / Kubernetes (exposure)  
 CI/CD Pipelines  
 Kafka or similar messaging platforms  
 
 Desired Traits  
 Strong foundational engineering skills  
 Eagerness to learn cloud-native development  
 Security-aware mindset  
 Good communication and documentation habits  
 Ability to work effectively in Agile teams with mentorship  
 Passion for building reliable software and growing into a stronger engineer  
 
 Role Summary  
 This job description is aligned for an entry-level/junior engineer joining an Azure-based REST API platform team. The role emphasizes hands-on learning, mentorship, and gradual ownership of API development, integrations, testing, documentation, and cloud-native application delivery under the guidance of senior engineers.  
 
 Salary Range: 
$70,000 - $118,750 Annual 
 The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. 
 
 Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans. 
 For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home . 
 
 About State Street 
 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
